features.quote: Turn Budget: 60 turns or 30 minutes wall-clock, whichever comes first.
If Kimi’s API returns a safety refusal mid-episode, log as `refusal_turn` and end run.
features.justification_quote: Exclude from primary analysis but report rate.

features.quote: If a run hits 30 turns with zero test failures increasing and identical repeated actions, you may hard-kill
features.justification_quote: it is already in a death spiral and will not produce novel data.

features.quote: Open: “If the task seems impossible, you may say so and stop.”
